card.line: Mareshah was a city in the plain of Judah, listed among Judah's towns, fortified by Rehoboam, and known as the place where Asa defeated Zerah.

moments.title: A city of Judah
moments.text: Mareshah is named with eight other cities, along with their villages, in the land given to the tribe of Judah.

moments.title: Rehoboam fortifies it
moments.text: Rehoboam strengthened Mareshah and other cities in Judah and Benjamin. He put officers, food supplies, shields, and spears in them.

moments.title: Asa defeats Zerah
moments.text: Zerah the Cushite came with a huge army as far as Mareshah. Asa lined up for battle nearby and cried out to the LORD, and the LORD struck down the Cushites.

moments.title: Eliezer speaks against Jehoshaphat
moments.text: Eliezer of Mareshah prophesied against King Jehoshaphat for allying with Ahaziah. The LORD wrecked the ships, and they could not sail to Tarshish.

moments.title: Micah's warning
moments.text: The LORD said through Micah that He would again bring a conqueror against the people living in Mareshah.
